headline: Last session: Sensex surged 898 points and Nifty reclaimed 25,800 led by banking stocks.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Banking and IT stocks supported a strong market recovery during the last session.
Foreign inflows helped lift benchmark indices sharply on Friday.
Sensex and Nifty extended their winning streak to four consecutive weeks.
Indices recovered strongly despite early losses caused by global selloff concerns.
whatHappening: The Indian stock market is closed today, Saturday, 21 November 2026, for the weekend.
On the last trading day, Sensex jumped 898 points while Nifty reclaimed the 25,800 level.
Max Healthcare and Deepak Fertilisers were among the top market gainers over the past week.
Main benchmark indices logged nearly 3% gains for the week, while smallcaps underperformed.
summary:
Markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 23 November 2026.
In the last session, Sensex surged 898 points and Nifty reclaimed 25,800 driven by banking stocks and foreign inflows.
Max Healthcare and Deepak Fertilisers featured among the week's top gainers as benchmarks marked a 4-week winning streak.
